Returns the latest web and API operations discovered from zone traffic.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: page (query) — Page number of paginated results.; per_page (query) — Maximum number of results per page.; host (query); method (query); endpoint (query); direction (query); order (query); diff (query); origin (query) — Filter results to only include discovery results sourced from a particular discovery engine * `ML` - Discovered operations that were sourced using ML API Discovery * `SessionIdentifier` - Discovered operations that were sourced using Session Identifier API Discovery; state (query) — Filter results to only include discovery results in a particular state. States are as follows * `review` - Discovered operations that are not saved into API Shield Endpoint Management * `saved` - Discovered operations that are already saved into API Shield Endpoint Management * `ignored` - Discovered operations that have been marked as ignored
